meta.purpose: Hypothesis registry for evaluating fully-local, performance-optimized LLMs on Unown's learning-layer subtasks. Each hypothesis is falsifiable, has explicit metrics, thresholds, guards, and a verdict updated by the testbench (benchmarks/local-llm/runner.mjs).
meta.method: Replay byte-faithful production prompts (mined from pi-repo/packages/self-learning/src) with fixtures captured from the live engine, against (a) the production remote model via the llm-bridge and (b) local llama.cpp + small GGUF quants. Blind A/B judged by the remote model with position-swap consistency. Cross-platform validated via the probe experiment on GitHub Actions matrix (linux/macos/windows) and locally.
meta.remoteBaseline: kimi-k2.5 via llm-bridge -> Dashscope (list $0.49/M in, $2.50/M out)
meta.localEngine: llama.cpp llama-server (MIT, pinned build, CPU, OpenAI-compatible, json_schema grammar)

localCandidates.lfm2.5-2.6b: Liquid LFM2.5-2.6B Q4_K_M (LFM Open 1.0, ~1.7GB) — BFCL-V4 56.9, extraction-focused hybrid arch

hypotheses.title: Local embedding model can triage session notes at remote-model agreement
hypotheses.statement: Routing note triage (benchmark/terminal/other + outcome) to a local nomic-embed-text-v2-moe embedding classifier achieves >= 0.85 agreement with the production model's labels at < 1s p50 per note and $0 marginal cost.
hypotheses.subtask: note triage (new capability feeding dream input curation)
guards: confidence threshold + deferral to remote for low-similarity cases (cascade pattern)
hypotheses.precedent: GLiNER/GLiNER2 beat ChatGPT on zero-shot NER on CPU (NAACL'24, arXiv 2507.18546); SetFit routers ~56x faster than LLM classification

hypotheses.title: Small local generative model matches remote on note triage quality
hypotheses.statement: A <= 1B local model (qwen3-0.6b / granite-4.0-1b) classifies notes with >= 0.90 kind-agreement and >= 0.85 outcome-agreement vs the production model, with valid JSON >= 95% of calls (grammar-constrained).
guards: deferral to remote on parse failure
hypotheses.precedent: OpenCode small_model for titles; Claude Code Haiku subagents; SLM summarization parity (arXiv 2502.00641)

hypotheses.title: Local models can draft failure-mining patches; remote verifies (cascade)
hypotheses.statement: A local 0.6B-2.6B model, replaying mineFailure() prompts, produces schema-valid mining results on >= 90% of real failed runs (with json_schema grammar), with judged quality not materially worse than remote (blind judge: local wins+ties >= 40% of judged pairs), at $0 marginal cost. Wall-clock on 2 vCPU will be prefill-bound and slower than remote — acceptable because mining is an async background job.
hypotheses.precedent: FrugalGPT (98% cost cut cascades); Aider architect/editor split; Cursor fast-apply (13x); Mem0 memory ops on small models

hypotheses.title: Local model can run AutoDream consolidation asynchronously at acceptable quality
hypotheses.statement: A local 2.6B model replaying runDream() produces a structurally valid next-memory (JSON valid, 60+ chars, <= 160 lines, no injected directives) and the blind judge does not consistently prefer the remote output (remote strict-win rate <= 60%), at $0 marginal cost. Latency is secondary (async job).
guards: canary gate (dream that breaks last-passing task is rolled back)
big-model diff review before ship (proposed integration)
hypotheses.precedent: Letta sleep-time compute (5x compute cut, +13-18% accuracy); Mem0 consolidation on gpt-4o-mini (+26% LOCOMO); GhostWriter poisoning risk -> verify gates mandatory

hypotheses.title: Local model can author valid benchmark task drafts (task minting)
hypotheses.statement: A local 2.6B model replaying mintCurriculumVariant() passes the harness's validateDraft() static contract on >= 50% of attempts (vs remote baseline pass rate), enabling a local-draft + sandbox-self-check + remote-verify pipeline.
guards: mint pipeline already self-checks drafts in a sandbox + validates via a real agent run before activation (unchanged)
hypotheses.precedent: Aider/Cursor role splits; curriculum generation is generation-heavy, verifier-gated

hypotheses.title: Cross-platform viability: llama.cpp + small quants run everywhere Unown runs
hypotheses.statement: The local lane (llama-server binary + GGUF) starts and serves grammar-constrained JSON on Linux x64/arm64, macOS x64/arm64 and Windows x64/arm64 within 30s cold start and a practical RAM budget (<= 2.5GB RSS for the 2.6B Q4 lane; <= 1.5GB for the 0.6B lane), using only official prebuilt binaries (no AVX requirement — runtime CPU dispatch).
hypotheses.experiment: E0-probe (run locally + GitHub Actions OS matrix)
guards: detect-and-use existing runtimes (Ollama/LM Studio) before spawning our own
hypotheses.precedent: llama.cpp ships 12-20MB prebuilts for 6 OS+arch combos, MIT license, runtime CPU dispatch sse42->sapphirerapids

hypotheses.title: Negative control: local small models must NOT replace the main agent brain
hypotheses.statement: Routing the pi agent session itself (main coding brain) to a local 0.6B-2.6B model collapses benchmark pass rates vs the remote baseline — confirming the scoping: local models are for AUXILIARY learning-layer subtasks only, not the agent loop.
hypotheses.experiment: E6-fullloop (phase 2, integration): run harness tasks with PI_MODEL_ID=local-*
metrics: task pass rate local vs remote
guards: n/a — this is the boundary experiment
hypotheses.precedent: SWE-bench: small models ~38% vs frontier 74-97%; OpenHands local timeouts

hypotheses.title: Integration shape: per-subtask routing via local-* model ids in the bridge
hypotheses.statement: The minimal-risk integration is (a) llm-bridge learns a local route (BRIDGE_LOCAL_URL; ids matching local-* forwarded there, keyless), and (b) self-learning/src/llm.ts gains an optional per-call model override with per-subtask env vars (PI_MINER_MODEL_ID, PI_DREAM_MODEL_ID, PI_MINT_MODEL_ID), so the agent session stays remote while background learning jobs can go local. Adoption happens only if H1-H5 verify.
hypotheses.subtask: integration design (only on success of H1-H5)
guards: every deferral logged with reason code
hypotheses.precedent: Mem0/Continue role-decomposed model configs; static routing beats learned routers (RouterArena)
